candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 as the deepest error in each failing checkout chain; inventory reservations succeed (200).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; payment 503 root cause (config, saturation, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: All failing checkout traces terminate at payment POST /v1/authorizations returning 503; order then returns 502 and gateway checkout 502. Inventory reservations succeed. Gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout. Bounded candidate: payment-side failure propagating upstream. Payment root cause unconfirmed; logs excluded.
